mechanics.definition: 单个符号实例携带运行时分配的金额、投注倍数或奖项值，并在满足明确兑现条件时计入结算或Feature终局。若同一实例可升级，初始赋值仍由Value Symbol指标拥有并使用独立初始赋值事件集；升级检查前当前值和逐次值转移必须通过value_upgrade_state_binding交给同实例ordered_scalar持久状态Owner，避免把初始赋值混入升级边际或新增同义升级指标。

conditional_packages.when: 动态奖值可映射到命名Jackpot层级
value_upgrade_rule存在；必须同时提供value_upgrade_state_binding并关联活动state.persistent-state(ordered_scalar)

evidence_signatures: each value-bearing symbol instance has a stable instance id and a traceable assigned value or tier
realized and unrealized instances can be distinguished at the declared settlement boundary
linked_multiplier_node_ids, when present, only declares a link and does not itself prove metric derivation

value_upgrade_state_binding, when value_upgrade_rule is present, proves stable instance identity, equal value domains, a separate initial-assignment event universe excluded from the before-upgrade observation marginal, initial assignment to initial state mapping, and exactly one ordered transition opportunity for every eligible upgrade check, including a self-transition when no upgrade occurs
exclusions: a symbol only has a static paytable payout
the displayed number is decorative and never enters settlement
an ordinary multiplier is not attached to a symbol instance

mechanics.definition: 具有稳定命名层级、独立触发规则、层级奖值模型和中奖后重置规则的奖项，独立于普通符号赔付表与最大中奖封顶。每个合格机会必须按tier_resolution_rule确定性归入至多一个统计层级，避免总体命中和层级构成重复计数。

conditional_packages.when: Jackpot层级通过盘面动态奖值符号承载

evidence_signatures: award event identifies a declared jackpot tier
tier_resolution_rule deterministically resolves every eligible opportunity to no hit or at most one declared statistical tier before tier counts are produced
tier value and post-award reset are observable or linked to an authoritative external pool response

jackpot_tier_exposure covers every declared tier exactly once and binds its common opportunity set, mutually exclusive resolved hit count and RTP contribution to a sealed evidence path, JSON pointer and hash
jackpot_material_owner_bindings, when present, maps the complete support of one active Primary metric to jackpot tier or no-hit on the same sealed event universe
exclusions: marketing labels such as GRAND that have no separate trigger, value model or reset semantics
